The '''115th''' was a military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]]. The unit fought in the [[battle of Corellia]]<ref name="First Strike" /> of [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="TOR dates">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> during which [[Darth Thanaton]] relieved the division's [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] and put his own [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Skar (Sith)|Skar]] in charge of the unit.<ref name="First Strike" />
